review.tagline: Python voice AI agent starter for LiveKit Agents
review.summary: A Python template for a voice assistant built on LiveKit Agents and LiveKit Cloud. It runs a voice pipeline through LiveKit Inference (default LLM Gemma 4 31B, default TTS Fish Audio S2.1 Pro) with turn detection, interruption handling and noise cancellation. It also ships simulation tests for CI, an AGENTS.md for coding agents, and a Dockerfile.
review.audience: Developers building voice AI agents on LiveKit in Python
strengths: Turn detection in 14 languages and adaptive interruption handling included by default
Simulation scenarios run in GitHub Actions on every merge to main
Pairs with web, iOS, Android, Flutter and React Native starters, plus telephony
Includes AGENTS.md, a terminal console and a text-turn debugger for coding agents
weaknesses: Defaults depend on LiveKit Cloud and LiveKit Inference; a LiveKit account is needed
Self-hosting means swapping in model plugins and removing the cloud noise cancellation plugin
Documented setup requires LiveKit CLI 2.18.8 or later
Simulations use real inference, so CI runs incur cost
needs: Python, Gemma 4 31B (LiveKit Inference), Fish Audio S2.1 Pro TTS, OpenAI, Cartesia
Needs LiveKit Cloud, LiveKit CLI 2.18.8+, uv
